_comment: 012. Every word the game uses, with its meaning in one or two lines. `forms` are the spellings linkify turns into links (whole words, any case); a term with no forms is in the GLOSSARY screen but never linked, because its word is too common to link safely (line, set, range...). Text only: NOT in the content hash.

turn.name: Your turn
turn.text: Each machine can move once and attack once (or use an ability), in any order. Then END TURN: the enemies do exactly what they showed.

intent.name: Intent
intent.text: What an enemy will do when you end your turn, drawn before you move: red hexes and a numbered badge. Move out of the red, kill it first, or shove it off its line.

heat.name: Heat
heat.text: Every attack adds heat. At the heat cap the machine overheats: it skips its next round's attack, then its heat drops to zero. Machines vent a little every round.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.text: Reaching the heat cap. Next round the machine is seized: it can move but not attack.

vent.name: Vent
vent.text: Spend the attack to dump all heat (V). Every machine also vents its vent number each round on its own.

armour.name: Armour
armour.text: Takes that much off every hit it suffers. A hit always does at least 1.

damage_type.name: Damage and armour types
damage_type.text: The core sets the damage type: kinetic, thermal, EMP or corrosive. Each lands 30% harder on one armour type (composite, reactive, shielded, plate) and 30% softer on another.

objective.name: Objective
objective.text: Every fight asks for something, shown top left. ROUT: destroy every enemy. DEFEND: keep the caches standing for some rounds. SALVAGE: collect enough scrap piles. Destroying every enemy always wins.

cache.name: Cache
cache.text: A salvage cache in a DEFEND fight: it cannot move or fight. Every cache still standing at the end pays out scrap.

melee.name: Melee
melee.text: Hits one hex next to the machine.

shot.name: Shot
shot.text: Flies in a line up to its range; the first thing in the way takes it. Of two equally short lines it takes the clear one.

lob.name: Lob
lob.text: Arcs over everything and lands on a hex between its minimum and maximum range.

range.name: Range
range.text: How far a shot or lob reaches, in hexes. A marksman frame, a ridge, a targeting rig or a Vektor set add to it.

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.text: Pierce N: the shot goes through the first N things in its line (machines, drums, crates) and hits the one after, then flies 2 hexes past its range at half damage. The rail lance (pierce 1) hits two in a line; tuned to Double Pierce (2), three; the rail driver (9), everything.

splash.name: Splash
splash.text: Also hits every hex around where it lands.

chain.name: Chain
chain.text: Chain N: after the hit the arc jumps N more times, each jump to a hex next to the last and 1 weaker. It takes the route that does the most damage (a drum by two enemies beats a lone enemy) and never jumps into your own machines. Scrap heaps conduct: it runs through them for free.

shove.name: Shove
shove.text: Pushes the target one hex straight away. Into something solid, both take 1; into a pit, it falls. A shove that kills throws the wreck: whatever it lands on takes the bump (a drum goes off), and its scrap goes where it lands.

tear.name: Tear
tear.text: A hit of 5 or more, or any hit from a weapon that tears, rips an arm off: that weapon is gone for the rest of the fight.

mark.name: Mark
mark.text: The next hit on a marked target deals 2 more, then the mark is spent.

cover.name: Cover
cover.text: Rubble and scrap heaps: shots at a machine standing in cover do 1 less. Melee ignores it.

rubble.name: Rubble
rubble.text: Costs 2 to cross and gives cover. In the move range it shows dimmer, so a route that goes round it is a choice you can see.

scrap_heap.name: Scrap heap
scrap_heap.text: Blocks movement and shots: the best cover on the field. Metal conducts: a chain arc runs through a heap to whatever stands beyond it.

slag.name: Slag
slag.text: Anything standing on slag at the start of a round takes 1.

ridge.name: Ridge
ridge.text: High ground: costs 2 to climb, and shots and lobs from it reach 1 further.

pit.name: Pit
pit.text: Nothing walks in. Anything shoved or dragged into a pit is gone.

drum.name: Fuel drum
drum.text: Explodes when hit: 3 damage to everything next to it, and it sets off the next drum along.

crate.name: Crate wall
crate.text: Blocks movement and shots until it is broken (3 HP).

pile.name: Scrap pile
pile.text: What a wreck leaves. End a move on it (or Magnet it) for scrap and 2 HP. Enemies grab them too.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.text: An enemy with the scrap mark on its tag carries scrap: it drops a pile when destroyed. The others drop nothing.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.text: Its shot locks onto a machine, not a hex, and follows it. Break its line, get out of range, kill it or shove it.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.text: Explodes when destroyed: 4 damage to every neighbour, its own side included.

warden.name: Warden
warden.text: Its neighbours take 2 less from every hit. Kill it first, or pull its friends away.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.text: An old yard guard, plated and bolted down: it takes 1 less from every hit and cannot be shoved. Found on the Slag Flats. Bring damage, not a push.

pour.name: The Pour
pour.text: The Slag Flats' keeper. Every other round it marks the hexes your machines stand on; a round later those hexes are slag for the rest of the fight (2 damage a round to anything on them). Keep moving, and break it before the floor runs out. At half HP it boils over: every round, four hexes, 3 a round, and three guard drones.

hive.name: Hive
hive.text: Sets down a pad beside itself that builds a drone every 2 rounds, warning red the turn before. Stand on the pad to block it; destroy the hive to shut it down.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: Run up to 3 hexes in a straight line, even after moving, and slam into the first thing in the way: 3 damage, +1 for every hex run first, and a shove.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.text: Hook a unit 2-3 hexes away and drag it next to you. Over a pit, it falls.

barricade.name: Barricade
barricade.text: Drop a crate wall on an empty neighbouring hex.

focus.name: Focus
focus.text: Free: the next attack or Charge this turn deals +2.

dash.name: Dash
dash.text: Free: move again, up to 2 hexes, even after attacking.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.text: Free: the next attack or Charge this turn deals +2, for +2 heat.

shield.name: Shield
shield.text: This machine and every ally next to it take 2 less from each hit until your next turn.

magnet.name: The Magnet King
magnet.text: Act 2's warlord: every other round it hauls each of your machines within 3 a hex toward itself -- into pits, into each other.

cooldown.name: Cooldown
cooldown.text: Rounds until an ability can be used again. FREE abilities do not use the machine's attack.

role.name: Role
role.text: The frame's trait. BRAWLER: +1 melee damage. LINE: can move after attacking. MARKSMAN: +1 range. ANCHOR: cannot be shoved or grappled.

sockets.name: Parts
sockets.text: A machine is five parts: a FRAME (HP, move, role, an ability), a CORE (damage type, heat), two ARMS (one weapon each) and a MODULE (a bonus, often an ability).

level.name: Level
level.text: Bought in the garage with scrap (15, 25, 40): +2 HP and one perk of three. Levels show on the machine as new armour.

perk.name: Perk
perk.text: What a level-up adds besides HP: one of three offered, kept for the run.

tune.name: Tuning
tune.text: At a workshop, re-cut a part one of two ways, once. A tuned part is marked +.

maker.name: Makers and sets
maker.text: Every part has a maker. Two parts from one maker on a machine add a bonus; three add a second. KESSLER: +2 HP, then +1 armour. ARCLIGHT: vents 1 more, then abilities a round sooner. VEKTOR: +1 move, then +1 range. CINDER: +2 heat cap, then +1 damage.

wreck.name: Wreck
wreck.text: A machine destroyed in a fight keeps only its frame. A workshop rebuilds it at half HP with empty sockets.

reclaimer.name: The Reclaimer
reclaimer.text: The machine that follows the key. Every 2 moves it swallows a column of the map; moving out of swallowed ground costs every machine 2 HP.

scrap.name: Scrap
scrap.text: The run's only currency: from fights, piles, scrapyards and breaking parts down. It buys levels, tuning, repairs, rebuilds and room in the hold.

hold.name: Hold
hold.text: An objective: start a round with one of your machines on the blue zone and no enemy on it; do it the number of times asked (or destroy every enemy). Enemies come to contest it.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.text: A site to patch the crew, rebuild a wreck, buy room in the hold and tune parts, for scrap.

elite.name: Elite
elite.text: A harder fight with a veteran; its salvage includes an uncommon or better part, already tuned.

gate.name: The gate
gate.text: The act's last fight. There is no road past it but through, and no road back.

pylon.name: Gate pylon
pylon.text: At the Sorting Gate: while any pylon stands, the Sorter takes 3 less from every hit (the red beams). Each has 6 HP. Break them first.

sorter.name: The Sorter
sorter.text: The Sorting Gate's keeper: big, armoured, shielded by the gate's pylons, and every 3 rounds it calls a drone from a pad beside it.

reclaimer_drone.name: Reclaimer drones
reclaimer_drone.text: Fight in the zone the Reclaimer takes next and its drones come in behind you at round 3, on red hexes marked a round ahead. Stand on one to block it.

trader.name: Trader
trader.text: Sells three parts for scrap (one of them tuned), and buys parts from your hold for twice what breaking them down pays.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.text: Climb it to scout every site within two zones.

signal.name: Signal
signal.text: An event by the road: a scene and two or three choices, each with its cost and its gain written on it.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.text: The Foundry Mind's relay, in the Crucible: every machine of its side next to it hits 1 harder (the red links). Kill it, shove it off, or split them up.

core.name: The Core
core.text: The Crucible's heart and the run's last fight. It never moves. Every third round it marks every hex within 2 of it, and a round later pulses: 4 damage to each of your machines still in the ring. Hit it, then get out before it pulses. At half HP it erupts: every other round, 3 hexes out, for 5, and three guard drones.

flue.name: Furnace flue
flue.text: An iron grate over the Crucible's furnaces. Every other round it blows: 3 damage to whatever stands on it. The round before, it is marked red.

hack.name: Hack
hack.text: An objective: end a move on a terminal to take it for good; take the number asked (or destroy every enemy).

survive.name: Survive
survive.text: An objective: waves of drones come in on the far row, marked a round ahead (stand on a mark to block it); outlast the rounds (or destroy every enemy).

grinder.name: The Grinder
grinder.text: Act 1's warlord: at the start of every round, 2 to each of your machines next to it. Hit it from range, or hit and step away.

twin.name: Twin Furnace
twin.text: Act 3's warlords, a pair: each takes 2 less while the other stands. Break one, then the other.

warlord.name: Warlord
warlord.text: One per act, in the middle of the map: a named fight with its own rule, a detour you choose. Its hoard holds a legendary part.

legendary.name: Legendary
legendary.text: The rarest parts, from a gate's or a warlord's hoard, and rarely from Act 3's salvage. Never on an enemy.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.text: A machine that hits this one in melee takes this much back (Spiked Plating). Enemies can carry them too: check a target before you punch it.

repairs.name: Repairs
repairs.text: Gets HP back at the start of every round, never past its maximum (the Repair Drone, the Phoenix Cell).

last_stand.name: Last stand
last_stand.text: The first blow that would wreck it in a fight leaves it at 1 HP instead. Once a fight (the Phoenix Cell).
